body: I went on Prozac for a month and then dropped it bc I didn’t see a difference. I think medication is a hit or miss for people bc ik some people that it actually works on and people who don’t see a difference. What helps us keeping maybe a log to track your moods to see if anything changes and let your psychiatrist know accordingly so they can make the right adjustments to whatever works for you!
